statement: The invoice record indicates that invoice 88412 was already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291 despite displaying a status of unpaid and due.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the invoice "was already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291 despite displaying a status of unpaid and due," naming the internal contradiction that makes the status value wrong.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
